consequence.statement: This is a new beta cleanup mechanism that will only become the default in a future release, so nothing breaks for existing environments in 1.13.0.

original.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds a beta, finalizer-based cleanup that makes sure Kyverno-managed webhook configurations are removed on uninstall. It is not yet the default cleanup strategy.

decision.reason: [ev-653d842efc60] calls the finalizer-based webhook cleanup a new beta feature that "will be used as the default cleanup strategy in the future", which means it is not the default in 1.13.0. The evidence names nothing that fails, is rejected or stops working for an operator who does nothing. The existing auto-cleanup on uninstall keeps working as before. The rendered CRD and Service diffs [ev-9348cb2d7f00, ev-bcf9822c2eb4] are unrelated to this change, so "none" with low severity is supported; confidence is low because the evidence does not say outright that the feature is off by default.
